dip to KEY-7 (signed K7 r2): the knob (fixed bar, variable-start bar, cushion gap) over two big columns (before 1981 / from 1981), red = share costlier
one control, two halves of history
K7 1.0 s: the gap starts to open (0 -> 1 point); the fixed bar never moves
K7 2.0 s: gap at 1 point; red columns shorter
K7 2.8 -> 3.4 s: gap opens to 1.5 points (Leah)
K7 4.4 -> 5.0 s: gap 2 points; right column empty (bright outline), '0%' in it (gap20_late)
K7 6.0 s: '0%' label leaving; left column still red
K7 8.0 s: '10.5%' over the left column's red (gap30_early); held to the end of the beat (S10.3)
